integrity: Exact integer enumeration over a provably exhaustive bounded range; no external paper is embedded; no independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact first-gap classification concerns finite integer supports of diameter at most nine, not general groups or larger diameters. The prior existence of a strict chi–D gap was acknowledged in 2015; independent historical priority remains uncertain. The finite enumeration is fully bounded and reproducible but has not undergone independent mathematical review.
title: The first strict pairwise Davenport gap has diameter nine and a unique support
